import ccxt, pandas as pd

exchange = ccxt.binance\({'enableRateLimit': True}\)
candles = exchange.fetch_ohlcv\('SOL/USDT', '1m', limit=50\)
df = pd.DataFrame\(candles, columns=['ts','open','high','low','close','volume']\)

delta = df['close'].diff\(\)
gain = delta.where\(delta>0,0\).rolling\(14\).mean\(\)
loss = \(-delta.where\(delta<0,0\)\).rolling\(14\).mean\(\)
df['rsi'] = 100-\(100/\(1+gain/loss\)\)
e1 = df['close'].ewm\(span=12\).mean\(\)
e2 = df['close'].ewm\(span=26\).mean\(\)
df['macd'] = e1 - e2
df['signal'] = df['macd'].ewm\(span=9\).mean\(\)

rsi = df['rsi'].iloc[-1]
macd = df['macd'].iloc[-1]
sig = df['signal'].iloc[-1]

rsi_oversold = rsi < 45
rsi_trending = 45 <= rsi <= 70 and macd > sig
would_buy = rsi_oversold or rsi_trending

print\(f'RSI:         {rsi:.1f}'\)
print\(f'MACD:        {macd:.4f}  Signal: {sig:.4f}'\)
print\(f'Oversold:    {rsi_oversold}  \(RSI < 45\)'\)
print\(f'Trending:    {rsi_trending}  \(45 < RSI < 70 and MACD+\)'\)
print\(\)
print\(f'WOULD BUY:   {would_buy}'\)
" 2>&1)
